question: On what specific lunar occasion should a person bathe at Tripurā to gain the stated merit?
premises: A person performs bathing at Tripurā.
The bathing occurs on the twelfth lunar day.
That day falls in the bright fortnight.
inference: A person should bathe at Tripurā on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight.
uncertainties: The main result of this bathing is stated in the following verse.
plain_english: A person, having bathed at Tripurā on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight.
